prompt: How many promotions started in each half of the year, and how deep were they on average? half_year is the text '2024-H1' when start_date is from 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30, '2024-H2' when it is from 2024-07-01 to 2024-12-31, '2025-H1' when it is from 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30, and '2025-H2' when it is from 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31, both days included each time. Every promotion has a start_date in one of these periods. Use the promotions table. Return three columns, in this order: half_year, n_promotions, the number of promotions, and avg_discount_pct, the average discount_pct. Return one row per half_year that has at least one promotion. Do not round. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the calculated column half_year with one branch per half year, then count and average per half year.
Each half year ends on 30 June or 31 December and both ends count, so a promotion that starts on 30 June belongs to the first half. Group by the label you built.
why_this_works: The CASE turns each start_date into its half year label, and grouping by that label counts and averages the promotions of each half.
